_about: The demo of the learning template: a small Spanish course, a tutor and three learners. Read by server/demo-loader.js, which writes it through the real module routes; the format is described in templates/demo/travel.json and the loader. Its phases are measured by goals, so the goals that name a phase say how far along it is. Dates are offsets: "start" is the practice exam (today plus "anchor" days).

doc:journal1.preview:
# Learning journal

## Week 5

**What I learned:** the past tense of ir and ser are the same, fui. The sentence tells you which.

**What was hard:** hearing the difference between "hablo" and "habló" at full speed.

**Next:** podcast episode 13, and the map of my street.

## Week 4

**What I learned:** I told the group about my weekend: "Fui al mercado y compré pan." Nobody laughed.

doc:verbsht1.excerpt: Past tense cheat sheet Verb I you he, she hablar (to speak) hablé hablaste habló comer (to eat) comí comiste comió ir, ser (to go, to be) fui fuiste fue hacer (to do) hice hiciste hizo tener (to have) tuve tuviste tuvo estar (to be) estuve estuviste estuvo Tip: the accent on the last letter changes
doc:verbsht1.preview:
# Past tense cheat sheet

| Verb | I | you | he, she |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hablar (to speak) | hablé | hablaste | habló |
| comer (to eat) | comí | comiste | comió |
| ir, ser (to go, to be) | fui | fuiste | fue |
| hacer (to do) | hice | hiciste | hizo |
| tener (to have) | tuve | tuviste | tuvo |
| estar (to be) | estuve | estuviste | estuvo |

text:verbsht1:verbshc1.text:
# Past tense cheat sheet

| Verb | I | you | he, she |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hablar (to speak) | hablé | hablaste | habló |
| comer (to eat) | comí | comiste | comió |
| ir, ser (to go, to be) | fui | fuiste | fue |
| hacer (to do) | hice | hiciste | hizo |
| tener (to have) | tuve | tuviste | tuvo |
| estar (to be) | estuve | estuviste | estuvo |

Tip: the accent on the last letter changes who did it. Hablo is "I speak"; habló is "he spoke".
